geeklist.title: ENDS TONIGHT @ 7PM PST - Space > $$$. No BIN $10 shipping auction with only $10 starting bids!
geeklist.description:
All items will have a starting bid of $10.
Highlights include: * Mosaic and the Wars Expansion * Marvel Dice Throne Missions * Dice Throne Adventures * Vantage * The rare Zombicide President's Box
Here are the rules for this auction:
* All bids must be in whole US dollars. * All items have starting prices, please don't bid below that. A legal bid is one that meets or exceeds the Starting Bid, and exceeds the previous legal bid. * I will conduct the sale through geekmail, you can expect a mail the day after the sale completes asking for your address for the sale. I'll use this address to calculate shipping. * PayPal or Venmo will be fine and I expect to pay the associated fees. I can do local pickup in Bellevue, WA (98006) area anytime - let me know and we can set something up to avoid shipping. * Winners of the item must pay in full within 2 days of winning an item, or the sale may be cancelled, unless we have made some other arrangement. Communication is the key to all happiness. * I reserve the right to remove or change the listing for any item in this auction at any time before the auction has been declared ended. I won't remove an item from the auction if it has bids unless I have notified the bidder(s) first and explained the situation. I also may add items along the way.
SHIPPING
* Shipping will be paid by the buyer but to a maximum of $10 (except where noted - just Mosaic this time which is huge). * I will combine shipping for multiple wins. * I will typically ship within 48 hours of receipt of payment. * Ships (or can be picked up) from 98006 (Bellevue, WA) * Sorry, no international shipping at this time.
OTHER NOTES
* The auction will end around 7pm PST on THURSDAY evening of the 18th of December. Don't snipe, it's mean. I will let bids continue on active items until there has been no bid for more than 1 hour.
